messages:
clare: Heads-up: I'm opening a lockfile refresh + tiny submodule bump for telemetry-client to pull in a security patch. Cutoff is ~4h (18:00 PDT). Can folks verify CI matrix and the changelog bullet?

sanjay: I can watch CI. Noted flaky mac dep-sanity on openssl mismatch earlier; will try to reproduce.

tanya: I'll draft the changelog line: "telemetry-client: security fix; lockfile refresh". Want a note about runtime behavior change?

clare: No functional changes expected, just dependency pin. Add a line about backport intent.

owen: If this alters TLS libs we should branch-and-backport to release/v1.9. I can stage the backport once CI green.

ci-bot: dep-sanity (macos) failed — https://ci.internal/jobs/dep-sanity/2071112345 — stderr: "dyld: Library not loaded: @rpath/libssl.3.dylib"

sanjay: reproduced locally, it's openssl@3 vs system-libs drift on mac runners. I'll prepare a quick patch to the mac job that pins brewed openssl@3.

clare: Please link the PR and mark it as temporary in description. We'll aim to land main then cherrypick.

tanya: changelog updated in the PR description and in the release notes draft. Added contact: "contact @clare or @owen if backport needed".

sanjay: PR #8532 opened with mac job pin and test matrix tweak. Mac runner green on my end.

release-bot: Reminder: merge freeze at 18:00 PDT (in ~3h) — only fixes affecting release safety allowed after cutoff.

owen: I'll create the release/v1.9-backport branch and prepare the cherry-pick instructions. Will wait for the merge signal.

clare: Plan: land submodule + lockfile on main. If any mac flake remains we keep the mac job patch. After main is green I'll ask @owen to push backport.

tanya: ack. One ask: try to avoid additional dep bumps in the same PR set. Keeps revert less risky.

clare: Agreed. Minimal change. Merging queued once CI passes final run.

backport-bot: Backport branch prepared: release/v1.9-backport — use CHERRYPICK-READY label for auto-apply.

owen: noted. Will push once @clare says go.

ci-bot: final matrix passed — all green.

clare: Merged on main. Filing backport now.

tanya: thanks all. I'll monitor release notes and ensure the changelog gets into the cut.

release-bot: Freeze in effect. No new merges without oncall approval.

clare: closing thread; ping here for post-merge regressions. :tada:
